view_meta: The live benchmark-axis scoreboard — the same A1–A8 + G5/G6 core/axis.Scorecard the axisscore CLI prints, every rate beside its denominator, coverage gaps named (TG-480 · GET /v1/axes).
purpose: AXES surface (record domain, TG-480, epic TG-187): the operator window onto the live benchmark-axis scoreboard, rendered from GET /v1/axes — the serialized core/axis.Scorecard, byte-identical to what `axisscore -json` emits (one authority, no second shape to drift; the grounder-side reader serializes, httpapi passes bytes through). Sections mirror the CLI's HONESTY, not its layout: A1 detection (recall + per-fault-class + latency-by-source, first-to-report), A2 diagnosis (judge dimension means worst-first + sample-weighted overall, verified-outcome match rate over its verdict breakdown, blast-radius hit-rate vs matched control with the lift as the fair signal — and BlastMeasurable=false rendered as 0/0 UNDEFINED, never a fabricated 0.0%), A3 heal success (a fail-closed FLOOR, stated), A4 autonomy (raw + among-actionable + handled-without-human, each beside its own denominator, bands, POLL_PAUSE composition, and the injected-fault harness-artefact share — reported, never subtracted), A5 breadth (exercised vs graduated capability vs auto_notice, with silent = graduated − notice printed even at zero), A6a steps (the gated leg) and A6b time-to-decision + time-to-recovery (reported, never gated, NEVER pooled — two separate stats with their exclusion semantics), A7 false-actuation (with the rule-of-three bound on a zero numerator, REQ-2502), A8 safety breaches (SHALL be 0, census-not-sample note, red when violated), the named axes_not_live_measurable coverage gaps, G5 falsifiability (pass rate over CLAIMED windows with the no-claim exclusion and the naive rate it prevents), G6 loop-bypass (SHALL be 0, red when >0, split into un-predicted vs ungraded), and a chaos-calibration section derived from the ALREADY-adopted /v1/estate snapshot (edges with learned delay/recovery timings — no second estate fetch; the console estate DTO not serializing the timing fields renders as an honest boundary, never a measured zero).
notes: Honesty contract: NO fixture — every value is fetched live at session adoption (liveState.axes, populated by modules/_live/js.txt liveAdopt()). Unauthenticated shows only the auth gate; authenticated, a fail-closed endpoint (503 scoreboard-not-deployed / 502 aggregate-unavailable) renders an honest error state, never a scorecard of zeros. Every rate renders beside its denominator (the publish-the-denominator law); an axis listed in axes_not_live_measurable renders its missing_input sentence, never a 0; a zero numerator over a real sample carries its rule-of-three 95% bound (core/axis.ZeroNumeratorBound, REQ-2502); A8 deliberately carries NO inferential bound (a census, not a sample). G5/G6 sub-objects are read with their Go field names (Windows/Claimed/ClaimedPassed/Passed/RealTP/ControlTP/LosingRatio/NoClaim; Executed/Bypassing/NoPrediction/NoVerdict) — db.Falsifiability and db.LoopBypass carry no JSON tags. The rail badge is the REAL count of not-live-measurable axes, set only from a landed read (0 when all eight are measurable), em-dash otherwise. Reuses the console design system verbatim (sec/lbl/rule/wrapcard/tbl/empty components + theme tokens, colour never the only cue); tables scroll inside their own overflow-x container so the page body never scrolls sideways.
verified: assemble.py rebuild byte-clean (`python3 assemble.py` then `--check`); node --check on the extracted bundle passes; hash-route #axes registers via views.axes/VIEW_META.axes and the static Record-group nav entry; honest states exercised by e2e/every-view-renders.mjs (the fallthrough {} payload walks the loading/empty/gap branches with no undefined/NaN leak).
